IGN:DistinctOMG
Banned for "Aimbot"  May 18th 2015 8:48 GMT By the user Kuznetsoz_
Why should I be unbanned? I was not hacking whatsoever, the game I was playing was TDM where it's one-hit-kill game and what i did was rush their spawn point and kept killing them all, it may of looked like I was hacking seeing how it was one-hit-kill. I was not hacking at all and I don't mind ss with anyone. Also it was a perm ban just because I kept knocking out their teammates with the bow (one-hit-kill) in their spawn and half of them could not make it out :/. I have been banned before but did not make an appeal because I was hacking at that time, but this time I was just playing normaly and gotten falsely banned. If there is a way to prove that I was not hacking please let me know and I'll be sure to show you whatever needs to be shown to prove that I was not hacking, thank you all for your time- DistinctOMG
